name: PJ3-97EC140
summary: PJ3-97EC140 is a planetary integrated actuator from Leadshine with EtherCAT communication for robotic joints. It has a 22:1 gear ratio and a listed rated output torque of 44 N·m at 80 rpm, with 140 N·m instantaneous maximum torque. The manufacturer specifies a 24–48 VDC supply, IP54 protection and a mass of 1200 g.
